text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is an open-house event for children 
to tour the academy. Active student racers 
are set to serve as their guides.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"—Now, everyone. Allow me to introduce our 
knightly guide for today— Sir Durandal has 
arrived!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome, mighty ones of the future. 
Fufu... All of your eyes are unclouded, I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: A, A... A knight?!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: It's a sword! Woah, so cool!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (...Heh, hehehehe...! Perfect...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the children really are overjoyed. 
Planning the performance with Durandal-san 
was totally worth it!
choice_data_list:
I hope you can become a role model for 
everyone as a knight.

It'd be wonderful if you could become a 
role model for everyone as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I shall definitely show 
those children the honor of a knight!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sir Knight! I wanna see the course, 
the course!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Fufu, understood! Now everyone! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with Durandal leading the way, the 
children dashed off. I hurriedly chased 
after them—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Here's the track—wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ...Where am I~?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
D-Drat...! I entered the wrong 
building...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... We somehow managed to get 
back... This time, it's onto the track...!

text_block_list.name: Deadpan Child
text_block_list.text: "...Um, lady? Are you really a knight?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Guh!?

text_block_list.name: Ruthless Children
text_block_list.text:
"How does getting lost fit the knight 
gig?" "It's just the outfit and sword that 
look the part..." "...A useless knight..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Guh! Gwah! Haugh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blades of words slashed mercilessly at 
Durandal...! And just like that, the 
children scattered away wherever their 
whims took them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone, no! Please come back~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, what a blunder...! I have failed as a 
knight...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However... I must carry out my duty until 
the very end— ...Hm!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over—one of the children was 
fiddling with a rake propped up at the 
edge of the track. The rake slowly began 
to tilt—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look out—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Durandal-san! It's a sword!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy threw a nearby sword over to 
Durandal. And with that, Durandal leaped 
into the air—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shielding the child, she slashed away the 
falling rake—and there stood Durandal 
amidst the cloud of dust, sword at the 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—I can protect you within the reach of my 
sword, but there will be times when you 
are beyond it. Do be careful.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Shall we all return to our 
original journey now?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: ...! S-S... So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's only natural. Sir Durandal 
is a true knight, after all!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heheheh...!
choice_data_list: You were a perfect role model.

You were a perfect role model, weren't 
you?
Back to our original tour route!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heheheh...!

you?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I wanna become a knight just like 
Sir Durandal~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we have a little order of knights 
now! Sir Durandal, why don't you bestow a 
name upon them?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then how about "The Order of the 
Holy Pure Knights"! Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal comes up with one chivalric order 
name after another to the kids' delight. 
She has truly become the "knight" they all 
look up to.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged! Next, I shall show you the 
school building! Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This is the cafeteria where we eat. The 
menu has carrot hamburg steaks, ramen, 
parfaits—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...So many! In any case, there are just so 
many of them!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! Sir Durandal, you're totally 
winging it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though a bit rough around the edges 
here and there, that was part of her 
charm. Durandal became quite popular and 
fulfilled her role as a guide to the end.
